target: Build a runnable demonstration of deployment gates using a versioned promotion and rollback gate. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

competency.title: Implement deployment gates — distribution shift
competency.outcome: Build a runnable demonstration of deployment gates using a versioned promotion and rollback gate. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

topic_kernel.artifact: a versioned promotion and rollback gate
topic_kernel.measure: false promotion rate and rollback readiness

competency.practice_task: Produce executable code or a runnable protocol grounded in a versioned promotion and rollback gate.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: executable code or a runnable protocol
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report false promotion rate and rollback readiness with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: promoting without independent evidence.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of deployment gates.
Practice: the artifact passes a new functional case and a failure case.
Measurement: report false promotion rate and rollback readiness against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for promoting without independent evidence; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
